tooManyRequests.title: Too Many Requests
tooManyRequests.description:
Too many requests were detected in a short period of time. Access is temporarily restricted to protect the system.
Please try again shortly.

userBanned.title: Account Suspended
userBanned.description:
Your account has been restricted due to violation of our terms of service or policies.
Please contact support for more information.

accountLocked.title: Account Temporarily Locked
accountLocked.description:
Your account has been temporarily locked due to multiple failed sign-in attempts or suspicious activity.
Please reset your password or contact support.

forbidden.title: Access Restricted
forbidden.description: Access to this resource has been blocked due to security policies or unauthorized access detection.

legal.title: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
legal.description: Access to this service is restricted in accordance with applicable legal regulations or official orders.

common.defaultDescription: Access has been restricted in accordance with security policies and usage rules.
